analysis:
Reviewed docs/architecture/inference.md, a documentation-only change. The visible patch updates the 'Last updated' date, adds a paragraph on cluster service health-file separation (DARKBLOOM_CLUSTER_MEMBER_HEALTH_FILE, service-health.json versus part-health.json), and rewrites the cluster runtime facts paragraph (signed release computes digests and registers cluster_runtime). Only base text for lines 4071-4930 was supplied, so the changed hunks at head lines 3528-3536, 5230-5235, 5250-5284, 5291-5294 and 5370-5372 are not visible in the supplied units. The patch excerpt is truncated, so I could not verify the remaining hunks.

No executable code, key handling, authorization logic or configuration defaults changed in the supplied material. The base text I examined (cluster SSD prefix record encoding, KV precision, GPT-OSS/MiMo/Gemma batch paths, manifest pins) is unchanged context. It stays consistent with T-041: encrypted SSD tier, binding of the encoding into the directory, header and load agreement, fail-closed refusal on mismatch, and lossy-by-contract restores.

Open questions for deeper review: (1) the code behind the new health-file behavior (ClusterServiceAgent.healthPath/partHealthPath, ClusterService.partEnvironment) was not supplied, so whether the supervisor liveness check's PID binding holds in code is unverified; (2) the claim that signed releases register cluster_runtime digests computed from the final app is a trust-contract change (release publication to qualification, A-017/A-011) whose backend and release-lane implementation sit outside this repo and were not supplied. Neither is evidence of a regression. Because those hunks are truncated, I set needs_deeper_review true as a precaution.
